content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto means you can directly reach your audience without relying on intermediaries. This approach not only eliminates the burden of platform fees, such as Gumroad's 10% cut, but also allows you to receive payments in cryptocurrency. With NOWPayments charging only 0.5%, the financial benefits are substantial. As a digital creator, this method empowers you to keep more revenue, ensuring your hard work translates into actual earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling Notion templates includes a combination of free and paid tools integrated to create a cohesive workflow. You can host your templates on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can be used to automate processes. With NOWPayments facilitating crypto transactions, you can ensure efficient payment verification, all while maintaining complete ownership of your data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Say goodbye to high platform fees and hello to more revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The essential components of this system include a hosting solution, backend logic, a payment processor, and file delivery mechanisms. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with Google Sheets or Supabase for order management, creates a robust framework. NOWPayments offers the crypto payment processing needed for seamless transactions, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 enables instant delivery of your digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose your hosting solution and set up your website using GitHub or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing. After that, integrate NOWPayments to enable crypto transactions. Finally, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product delivery, and ensure your setup is tested thoroughly before launching your store.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Empower yourself with full ownership of your digital products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I start selling Notion templates for crypto?

Begin by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend automation with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring seamless payments.
What are the fees associated with selling digital products?

Unlike Gumroad's 10% fee, which significantly cuts into your earnings, using NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This allows you to retain a larger portion of your revenue, making your sales more profitable.
Can I deliver digital products automatically?

Yes, by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage, you can automate product delivery. Combined with backend logic, your customers will receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
Is it possible to sell other digital products using this setup?
Absolutely. This infrastructure is versatile and can be used to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and more. It provides the flexibility to handle various types of digital products seamlessly.
What if I need support after setting up my store?
When you deploy your stack, you'll receive 30 days of support to address any questions or issues that may arise. This ensures you have assistance during the critical launch phase.
